hypothesis: Increase calibration fraction to provide a more robust threshold for the high-trust direct evaluation regime
rationale: With DIRECT_EVAL_WEIGHT at 0.90, the final knock probability is heavily determined by direct world sampling, making the system highly sensitive to the exact pre-committed knock threshold. Expanding the calibration split from 15% to 20% of the training data provides a larger, more representative sample for threshold tuning. This should reduce overfitting to the calibration set and improve held-out decision quality, easily justifying the small tradeoff in available eval time.
